title: Update note fields with PATCH
body:
Add partial note updates to the existing HTTP service.

- R1: PATCH /notes/{id} with title changes only the title and returns the updated JSON note.
- R2: PATCH /notes/{id} with tags changes only tags, preserves the ID and list order, and supports Unicode.
- R3: An empty title or invalid tags returns 400 without changing the note; an unknown ID returns 404. Add repository HTTP E2E tests.
